question: By whose grace is the speaker able to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
It is by the Lord's grace that knowledge arises.
Through that grace, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
inference: The Kaula determination is known to the speaker solely by the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas.
uncertainties: The prior state of ignorance is implied but not detailed.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
